summary: Cinder Vault dungeon HUD with depth/waypoint guidance, non-blocking level-up boon tray, armory rack, magazine display and reload state.
useWhen: Present Cinder's dungeon run, depth waypoint, experience and keyboard-operable 7/8/9 boon choices without pausing combat.
limitations: Consumes the Cinder family service; pointer-locked play uses keyboard selections. Desktop keyboard/mouse controls; the boon tray is intentionally non-modal.
